findings.claim: Across the observed score window [0.0,0.49] the landmark_00_local_dx curve is non-monotone: it rises to a positive peak near t~0.10-0.11, falls to a negative trough near t~0.19, then recovers toward zero by t~0.49; the whole-window mean is slightly negative (whole_window_z=-0.18) and the polynomial fit is not accepted (relative_node_RMSE=0.78, 6 sign changes, 9 strong sign conflicts).

landmark_00_local_dy shows a similar early-negative then late-recovery shape: values are most negative around t~0.05-0.09, cross near zero around t~0.14-0.19, and end slightly positive; whole_window_z=-0.30 with 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts, and no accepted polynomial.

landmark_00_local_dz is near zero early, becomes positive in the middle of the window (t~0.28-0.40) and turns negative at the end (last_z=-0.59, last_rate_z=-2.38); whole_window_z is essentially zero (-0.02) with 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts.

landmark_00_soft_mass is the only one of the eight read features with a clearly positive whole-window level (whole_window_z=+0.64): it rises from near zero to a positive plateau around t~0.14-0.30 and then decays toward zero by t~0.49, with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict.

landmark_01_local_dx and landmark_01_local_dy both show an early positive-to-negative excursion followed by partial recovery: dx peaks near t~0.05 then goes negative around t~0.14-0.19; dy is most negative around t~0.05-0.09 and recovers toward zero late. Both have whole-window means near zero (dx=-0.22, dy=-0.50) and multiple sign changes.

landmark_01_local_dz and landmark_01_soft_mass are near zero on the whole window (whole_window_z=-0.01 and -0.25 respectively) but show large early rate excursions (first_rate_z=-58.5 and -26.0) that reverse sign later, indicating transient rather than sustained displacement.

hypotheses.direction: non-monotone: positive early, negative mid-window, recovering late
hypotheses.falsifier: If the landmark_00_local_dx curve over the same window is monotone or its whole-window mean is not near zero, the transient-excursion description fails.
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score window [0.0,0.49]
hypotheses.statement: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate exhibits a transient positive excursion early in the window followed by a negative excursion and late recovery; a reward that tracks this coordinate should be evaluated against the observed non-monotone profile rather than a single signed target.

hypotheses.direction: positive whole-window level with mid-window plateau
hypotheses.falsifier: If landmark_00_soft_mass whole-window mean is not positive or its plateau is absent in an independent batch, the level-based interpretation fails.
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score window [0.0,0.49]
hypotheses.statement: landmark_00_soft_mass carries a sustained positive whole-window level with a mid-window plateau, unlike the near-zero whole-window levels of the dx/dy/dz coordinates; this makes it a candidate coordinate for a level-based (rather than contrast-based) reward term.

hypotheses.direction: near-zero whole-window level with opposing late-window rates
hypotheses.falsifier: If either dz curve has a non-near-zero whole-window mean or lacks the reported late-window rate sign, the full-window evaluation requirement is unsupported.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_local_dz and landmark_01_local_dz (predicted endpoint world-A features, z-scored)
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score window [0.0,0.49]
hypotheses.statement: landmark_00_local_dz and landmark_01_local_dz show late-window sign reversals (negative last_rate_z for landmark_00_local_dz, positive last_rate_z for landmark_01_local_dz) while their whole-window means are near zero, so any reward using these coordinates must be evaluated on the full window rather than on endpoint values alone.

limitations: Only 8 of 200 catalogue curve features were read; the remaining landmark coordinates (cxx/cxy/cxz/cyy/cyz/czz and landmarks 02-19) are unobserved and no claim is made about them.
No stage profiles or temporal profiles are available; all statements are restricted to the continuous curves over the observed score window [0.0,0.49].
All curves are z-scored predicted endpoint world-A features; no physical energy, chemical interaction, or absolute coordinate target is inferred from them.
Polynomial fits were not accepted for any of the eight read features (relative_node_RMSE 0.29-0.78), so no extrapolation beyond the observed window is supported.
Selection preference and these coordinate contrasts are associations only; they are not evidence of descendant survival or measured final affinity benefit.
